native_source.age_selection: Preserve named source calibrated point ages and [0,11700) half-open domain. Native age bounds and missing bounds remain unchanged; no age probability or calibration.

fixed_response.binding: Exact saved physical response and parameter scalars, not new quadrature or inferred basin truth. Source PPE is treated as fixed conditional input, not estimated-PPE confidence.

counting_model.one_request: One native aliquot, two actual measured literal taxa and its pair total N. Counts are assumed Binomial(N,p) conditional on the selected pair; this is a new declared counting model.
counting_model.interpretation: A confidence set for pair-relative conditional cover under fixed response/PPE, not entire vegetation cover or a Bayesian probability of the true cover.
exclusions: No pooling independent/heterogeneous aliquots into one binomial request.
No full-panel count total substituted for the pair denominator.
No simultaneous 95-interval family coverage or time-series correlation model.
No empirical field validation, historical reproduction, rights or scientific admission.
counting_model.zero_edges: No actual zero count axes occur in this source population. Retain separately identified existing synthetic API edge controls; missing taxa are refused, never zero-filled.

independent_oracle.endpoint_tails: Exact integer binomial polynomial at binary64 rational p; compute sum C(N,j) a^j (d-a)^(N-j) / d^N with independent integer recurrence. Accepted endpoints must satisfy exact binary64 alpha/2 inequalities without numerical tolerance. Check saved directed-Decimal certificate actually encloses the exact rational tail.
independent_oracle.cover_map: Exact Fraction from supplied binary64 response/PPE and p. Verify both complementary cover bounds outward-enclose exact transformed endpoints and match source count point estimates within2ULP; no clip.
independent_oracle.point_scope: Reconcile all24original occupied-window pooled point estimates with retained native results by exact source membership/count sums and quotient algebra only. These point checks do not introduce pooled confidence intervals or replace original SEs.

planned_focused_controls: Duplicate native sample or analysis unit identity
Missing or duplicated selected pair literal field refuses, not zero
Wrong source age profile or point-window assignment
Outside-domain sample retained as one refusal
Negative/noninteger or N>10000 source count refuses
Actual source has zero observed zero-axis requests; separate synthetic API zero edges labeled
Point-only pooled comparison has no interval claim
public_output_scope: Aggregate denominator, widths, bounds, exact numerical qualification and omissions; private native IDs/depths/counts/age vectors retained only under artifacts, not raw redistribution.
